task_definition.task_description: Please check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 is in stock, then look up both regular and trending alternatives in the same electronics category for me and choose one substitute to buy if needed. After that, reserve and confirm 1 unit of the Sony WH-1000XM5 Silver, get Alice’s contact details, generate a discounted PayPal invoice for 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 sent to alice@company.com, then look up Hilton Tokyo, get the current UTC time and convert that timestamp, and finally create and email me a high-priority document titled “Substitute purchase confirmation” noting that a substitute item was purchased, invoiced with discount, and that a travel hotel lookup was included.

user_input.query: Please check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 is in stock for me — product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity 1, in the electronics category. Then look up both regular and trending alternatives in electronics and choose one substitute to buy if needed. After that, reserve and confirm 1 unit of the Sony WH-1000XM5 Silver, get alice’s contact details, and generate a discounted PayPal invoice for the invoice_items [{product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity: 1}] for 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 sent to alice@company.com, using payment_gateway paypal and payment_method card. Also look up Hilton Tokyo, get the current UTC time and convert that timestamp for timezone UTC. Finally, create and email via channel email a high-priority document titled “Substitute purchase confirmation” with this content: “A substitute item was purchased, invoiced with discount, and a travel hotel lookup was included for the customer.” Please associate it with user_id user_123 and tags shopping, invoice, travel.
user_input.document_content: A substitute item was purchased, invoiced with discount, and a travel hotel lookup was included for the customer.
